name: anchorset
author: Ogous Chan Ali
description: Regression tests for your LLM evals, and checks on the judge that grades them.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/banner.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:pack
scripts.demo:drift: node src/cli.ts drift --old examples/refund-bot/anchor_old.json --new examples/refund-bot/anchor_new.json --flag handoff
scripts.demo:judge-change: node src/cli.ts judge-change --plan examples/judge-change/plan.json --bar examples/judge-change/bar.json --inputs examples/judge-change/runs
scripts.demo: node src/cli.ts gate --baseline examples/refund-bot/baseline.json --candidate examples/refund-bot/candidate.json --bar examples/refund-bot/bar.json --allow-differ systemModelServed,systemCallShapeHash
